About the PPRC Long Neck

A long neck stub end is butt-fused to the pipe and used with a loose backing flange to make a bolted joint. The longer neck gives room for the clamps of a butt-fusion machine and suits larger diameters.

About PPRC Fittings

PPRC fittings are socket-fused to PPR pipe and are widely used for hot and cold water distribution, compressed air and HVAC lines in buildings and plants. Threaded tees, elbows and adaptors connect to metal pipework and valves.
